title: Project Context
subtitle: Markdown documents from the synced default branch of {repo}. View-only — change them in the repository, then refresh. Attach them to agents and skills from their Context tab.
refreshFailed: Resync failed — showing the clone as it was last synced.
loadErrorBody: The document list could not be loaded.

noRepo.title: No repository selected
noRepo.body: Add or select a repository first — project context is read from its synced clone.

empty.title: No project documents found
empty.body: No Markdown files were found under {roots} in this repository’s synced clone. Add .md files under one of these folders in the repository, then refresh.

list.heading: Documents
list.select: Select a document to preview it.

footer.files: {count, plural, one {# file indexed} other {# files indexed}}

usedBy: {count, plural, one {Used by # agent} other {Used by # agents}}

preview.title: Preview
preview.readOnly: Read-only preview. Raw HTML, images and remote content in the document are not rendered.
preview.loadErrorBody: The document could not be read from the clone.

attach.heading: Project context
attach.intro: Documents attached here are read from the repository clone at the start of every run and sent to the model as untrusted data. Only the path and order are stored.
attach.introSkill: Project context to use. Every agent that uses this skill (with the link enabled) also receives these documents. Only the path and order are stored.
attach.warning: Above {limit} tokens — nothing is truncated, but this may be slow or costly.
attach.missingHelp: No longer found in the repository — it is skipped at run time.
attach.saveError: Could not save the attachments. The previous set is unchanged.
attach.loadErrorBody: The documents or attachments could not be loaded.
attach.noRepo: Select a repository to attach project documents.
attach.emptyList: No documents found under {roots}. Add .md files to the repository and refresh the Project Context page.
attach.serializesNote: Paths only — the full text is injected into the prompt at run time.
